notes: Rolling dated snapshots of state.json: your board now has a history you can go back to, not just a mirrored copy. One small dated copy per project per day, taken before the day's first change, kept inside the project so your existing backup carries it offsite unchanged. Capped at 2 MB per project - and when that fills, Stasys thins the middle rather than dropping the oldest, so how far back you can go never shrinks. It refuses to keep a copy it cannot read back.
